## Description

Internal functions for the structure of a linear regression model
with random regressors in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]:
the model-implied covariance matrix,
partial and standardized slopes,
R-squared and adjusted R-squared,
semipartial and partial correlations,
Cohen's f-squared,
and the Jacobian matrices of these quantities.
The functions have no input checks and are copied by other projects.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `strRegression` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/strRegression) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/strRegression")
```

## Example

The functions are internal, so they are called with `:::`.
The model-implied covariance matrix from the parameters
of a regression with two regressors.

```{r}
beta <- c(0.5, 0.3)
sigmacapx <- matrix(data = c(1, 0.2, 0.2, 2), nrow = 2)
sigmacap <- strRegression:::.SigmaofTheta(
  beta = beta,
  sigmasq = 0.4,
  sigmacapx = sigmacapx
)
sigmacap
```

R-squared and the standardized slopes from the covariance matrix.

```{r}
strRegression:::.RSqofSigma(sigmacap = sigmacap, k = 3)
strRegression:::.BetaStarofSigma(
  sigmacap = sigmacap,
  q = 1 / sqrt(x = diag(x = sigmacap)),
  k = 3
)
```
